dialogues.speaker: Fadaweh
dialogues.text: Huh... Hmm... As this is a task assigned by a senior, I can't afford to drop the ball... Oh! You're one of the testees... W—Why are you coming closer?

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Oh... Uhm... Why are you asking about Darwish all of a sudden? Are you curious, too? Hehe... It's only natural — he's a very reliable man...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Not to mention, he's very good with children... *sigh* I wish you could see him when he's teaching the young ones... Wait! No! No way!

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Only I'm allowed to watch Darwish teaching the children! You can't watch him! Don't you dare go and watch him!

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: ...Uhm... Erm... I'm sorry, I got a little carried away...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: *sigh* This is just the way I am... It's why I don't have many friends. Y—You don't think I'm... a bit of a joke too, do you?

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Not that I can do anything about it... but even so, Darwish's still willing to stand up for me!

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Heh, you mean the "simulated development" model I'm running? I assure you, it's based on meticulous calculations...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: It's just a shame about the data inputs... I could do a much better job if Atashye wouldn't just pull numbers out of thin air...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Honestly, doesn't that dunderhead realize what a rare opportunity it is to work on a project with Darwish?

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: ...*sigh* I shouldn't talk about him like that — he's put in a lot of work himself. Darwish's always saying that I expect too much from people. It's not a good trait.

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Even if the reports he submits are enough to make me want to scream...

choices.text: Is this too close for you? I can leave if you'd like...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Ah, oh, no, that's not what I meant... Ehm, but, thank you... for your understanding...
